meta.name: firecrawl-crawl
meta.description: Bulk extract content from an entire website or site section. Use this skill when the user wants to crawl a site, extract all pages from a docs section, bulk-scrape multiple pages following links, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract", or needs content from many pages on the same site. Handles depth limits, path filtering, and concurrent extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量抓取整个网站或站点目录的内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从网站或文档区批量提取所有页面内容
copy.tagline_en: Bulk extract content from an entire website or site section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract all pages from a website or docs section

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以批量抓取整个网站或某个栏目下的所有页面内容，并自动跟随链接，支持设置抓取深度、路径过滤和并发数。
howto.when: 当用户需要获取一个网站上多个页面的内容时触发，例如说“爬取这个网站”、“提取 /docs 下所有页面”或“批量抓取”。

say.text: 帮我爬取 https://example.com/docs 下的所有页面。
爬取这个网站，深度不超过3层，最多50页。
检查之前那个爬取任务的状态。
say.note: Claude 会使用 job ID 查询爬取进度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can bulk extract content from an entire website or site section by crawling pages following links, with support for depth limits, path filtering, and concurrent extraction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to crawl a site, extract all pages from a docs section, bulk-scrape multiple pages, or says "crawl", "get all the pages", "extract everything under /docs", "bulk extract".

say_en.text: Crawl https://example.com/docs and get all pages.
say_en.note: Claude uses --include-paths /docs to scope the crawl.

say_en.text: Crawl this site with max depth 3 and limit 50 pages.
Check the status of my previous crawl job.
say_en.note: Claude uses the job ID to query progress.
